INGLEWOOD  CALIFORNIA

  Library Board
  MINUTES – OCTOBER 23, 2019

The Inglewood Library Board met on October 23, 2019 at the Gladys Waddingham Lecture Hall. The
meeting was called to order at 6:34 p.m. by Board Member Pat Douglas.

Roll Call

Present:

  Pat Douglas – District 2 Board Member
  Ernesto Castillo – District 3 Board Member
  Jacqueline Cochran – District 4 Board Member

Absent Board Members:
  Patt Sanders – At Large Board Member, Chairman
  Julie Minton – District 1 Board Member, Vice Chairman

Staff:
  Harjinder Singh – Deputy to the City Manager
  Sabrina Barnes – Parks, Recreation and Community Services Director
  Frances Tracht – Library Manager
  Irina Martirosian – Staff Assistant

Approval of the Minutes

  Board Member Douglas made a motion for the approval of the minutes for September 18, 2019;
Board Member Cochran seconded the motion. Minutes were approved as follows:

  Ayes: Library Board Members Cochran, Castillo and Douglas
  Nays: None

Library Report

  Deputy to the City Manager Harjinder Singh gave an update on the renovation of the Main Library.
The City is in the process of hiring an architectural firm. Singh shared the current Library organizational
chart with Board Members to provide information where we are as an organization. Singh stated that this
will be the starting point to discuss additional staffing for the new library when it is completed. Singh also
requested a discussion item be added to the upcoming agenda to outline the potential for a library
bookstore to be operated by the Friends of Inglewood Public Library. Singh told Board Members that
Library staff is meeting with Friends of Inglewood Public Library to share ideas and he asked Board
Members to share their ideas as well.

  1
   Parks, Recreation and Community Services Director Sabrina Barnes told Board Members that the
November Meeting falls on Thanksgiving Eve and December Meeting falls on Christmas day. Barnes asked
to have a Special Meeting on the third Wednesday, the 20th of November. Barnes also mentioned that she
will not be at that meeting because of the Arts Commission meeting that she needs to attend on that night.
  Due to Thanksgiving and Christmas holidays, Board Member Douglas made a motion for Board
Members to have a Special Meeting on November 20, 2019 and to suspend the December regular Board
Meeting until January 2020. Board Member Cochran seconded the motion. Motion was approved as
follows:

  Ayes: Library Board Members Castillo, Cochran and Douglas
  Nays: None

  Library Manager Frances Tracht told Board Members that the Library is in the process of hiring an
Associate Librarian for Adult Services, a bilingual Children’s Librarian for the Crenshaw Branch and a
Principal Librarian for Adult Services. Tracht also mentioned that our Career Online High School Graduates
will be recognized at the City Council Meeting on Tuesday, October 29, at two o’clock and asked everyone
to attend. Tracht said it’s been really wonderful and she’s very excited about what’s happening.

Friends Report

  Susan Carleo, President, Friends of Inglewood Public Library, talked about a very special book
sale of just cookbooks on November 2, 2019. There will be a very interesting assortment of cookbooks of
all different kinds of cuisines donated by the library and the community. Carleo also, talked about the
“Inglewood Read”, a group that Friends of Inglewood Public Library formed, which was recognized by the
City Council for its commitment to promoting reading in our community for all ages and anybody who is
interested in books. Carleo was delighted to hear about our Career Online High School Graduates, a
program that Friends helped pay for through donations from the community.

Public Comments

  None

Commissioner Comments

  Board member Cochran liked the idea of “Inglewood Read”.
  All Board Members were excited about the new library.

  With no further comments the meeting was adjourned at 6:55 p.m.
